relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Application of capsaicin for 24 h after oxidative stress induction with SNAP led to increased axonal outgrowth, indicating the promotion of regenerative processes.

key_findings: Capsaicin upregulated the Nrf2/Ho-1/Nqo1 antioxidant cascade in naive DRG neurons and restored axonal growth under SNAP oxidative stress, partly via TRPV1 (capsazepine attenuated the effect).
In Schwann cells capsaicin raised ATP production and spare respiratory capacity and shifted myelination/repair markers in a context-dependent manner.
